_note: CFM / A-One pricing rules (Jeremy, Nov 13 2026) plus industry-standard cleaning speeds. Edit freely.

labor._note: default_hourly_wage is CFM's starting pay; each bid can override it. Payroll burden is built from the real taxes below, not a flat %.

production_rates_sqft_per_hour._source: Whole-room rates built from ISSA 612 task benchmarks (vacuum open carpet 3,000-5,000/hr; furnished offices 1,500-2,500/hr; damp mop 2,500-4,000/hr) and published facility benchmarks (schools 1,500-2,500/hr, medical about 2,500/hr). Restroom rate covers the floor only; fixtures are timed separately.

minutes_per_fixture._source: ISSA 612 fixture benchmarks: toilet about 5 min, urinal about 4, sink about 3.

floor_care._note: CFM per-square-foot prices, per service. Each bid can override them in the app.

price_band_per_sqft_month._source: Market checks: janitorial typically $0.07-$0.25 per sq ft; wide range $0.04-$0.50.

token_prices_per_million._source: gpt-6-luna, OpenAI standard pricing per 1M tokens (MGT 409 Lecture 11; same as HW6 data/prices.json)

payroll._source: 2026 employer rates: Social Security 6.2% (cap $184,500), Medicare 1.45%, FUTA 0.6% on first $7,000, Alabama SUTA 2.7% (CFM rate, per Jeremy) + 0.06% Employment Security Assessment on first $8,000. Workers' comp: AmTrust quote for A-One, 5/28/2026, class 9014 at $1.683 per $100; total premium $5,918 on $350,000 payroll = 1.69% all-in.

account_costs._note: Liability insurance 0.05% (Jeremy, Nov 23). Equipment 3% of labor = median of 73 CFM recurring bid calculators (range 1-25%).
